name: Traycer Orchestration
purpose: Orchestrate AI-assisted build execution with Traycer as a replaceable adapter: canonical repository Goals, traced plan graphs, verification-gated steps, checkpoints with resume, and replayable audit trails.
inputs: Locked Goal with measurable acceptance criteria and frozen plan-graph version
Adapter interface version with plan, dispatch, trace, checkpoint, and replay operations
Checkpoint policy: checkpoint per green gate, retain last 20 checkpoints per plan
Budgets: max 25 plan steps, max 3 retries per step, 20-minute step timeout
outputs: Executed plan with per-step artifacts, gate verdicts, and trace completeness report
Checkpoint set enabling resume from the last green state
Replayable audit trail mapping every artifact to its creating ledger entry
stop_conditions: All plan steps green with trace completeness at 100% and Goal acceptance criteria satisfied
A step blocks after 3 failed gates and the plan halts for human re-planning
